the proposed methodology can provide a better load restoration during an outage than the traditional two stage approach.

the operation of CMGs in distribution systems, which are a key component of the smart grid infrastructure.
the operation of CMGs in a distribution network.
the development of a three stage hierarchical scheduling and dispatch framework for the dynamic operation of community microgrid.
